description: This file defines the INativeJS interface, an abstract class specifying methods for managing NativeJS plugins, including initialization, creation, execution, retrieval, and termination of applications within a plugin framework.

classes.name: INativeJS
classes.description: An interface for NativeJS plugin management, supporting initialization, application creation, execution, retrieval, and termination.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the specified Wayland display.

methods.name: CreateApplication
methods.description: Creates a NativeJS application with specified options and outputs its ID.

methods.name: RunApplication
methods.description: Runs a specified NativeJS application by ID and URL.

methods.name: RunJavaScript
methods.description: Executes JavaScript code within a specified application ID.

methods.name: GetApplications
methods.description: Retrieves details of existing NativeJS applications.

methods.name: TerminateApplication
methods.description: Terminates a running NativeJS application by ID.
